hypothesis.statement: The v2 capture failures are caused by calculating only vertical orthographic fit and using insufficient exposure for the narrow 9:16 Looking Glass Go panel.
hypothesis.action: Fit camera scale to max(subject height, subject width / panel aspect) and increase exposure from 0.65 to 1.65.
hypothesis.expectedResult: No subject clipping and foreground median luminance above 55/255 for all five identity views.
hypothesis.actualResult: Capture gate improved from 0/5 to 5/5; median luminance is 72.084-79.16/255 and minimum horizontal margin is 3.6806%.
hypothesis.decision: keep v3 camera and exposure protocol
